entries.zh: 勒逼；强迫；勒索
entries.en: to importune, to press insistently; to coerce, to extort

entries.zh: 逼迫；催逼（以言语劝诱相逼）
entries.en: to press, to compel; to urge (with entreaties)
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺（con comedimien[残]），据西语词头、「迫」字与闽南音写互证释义

entries.zh: 催促；促使；逼迫
entries.en: to urge on, to hasten; to press

entries.zh: 局促；拘束不安（受逼迫而局促）
entries.en: constrained, cramped; hard-pressed

entries.zh: 遮掩；掩蔽〔「掩」与词头「纠缠催逼」之义难以互证，音写尾段无法释读，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to cover, to screen [semantic link with the headword unclear; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 音写「ingietariog」无法释读，「掩」义与 importunar 不合，且声调号有 T99 污损

entries.zh: （首字存疑：扐／扔）掷、抛开；确义待考
entries.en: (head character uncertain) to throw, to cast aside; exact sense unconfirmed
entries.notes: 首字存疑（扐／扔），四栏互证不足，仅按候选字义姑拟

entries.zh: 絮聒、纠缠不休（原字「劳造」不成词，据词头与音写推断为絮叨扰人之义）
entries.en: to nag, to pester with talk (characters garbled; sense inferred from the headword importunar)
entries.notes: 「劳造」疑为「嘮噪」类词之误录，释义系推断而非四栏直接互证

entries.zh: 劳苦、烦累（第二字存疑：楷／楛，疑为「苦」）
entries.en: to trouble, to weary (second character uncertain, probably 苦 'hardship')
entries.notes: 第二字存疑且声调号有 T99 污损，「劳苦」义系据「劳」字与音写推断

entries.zh: 〔语义难定〕原字「百教」与西语残文难以互证，义待考
entries.en: sense undetermined: Spanish qualifier ('malcauten fa disco') illegible, Chinese opaque
entries.notes: 西语栏「malcauten fa disco」无法释读，「百教」义不明，无法定夺

entries.zh: 钳粘；死缠不放（缠粘纠缠）
entries.en: to cling to and grip someone; to pester insistently

entries.zh: 局促；拘束不安；受逼迫
entries.en: constrained, cramped; hard-pressed, ill at ease

entries.zh: 清澈（首字存疑：湄／渭；音写「fiev」无法释读，释义存疑）
entries.en: (of water) clear, limpid [head character uncertain; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 首字存疑、音写「fiev」难释且声调号 T99 污损，释义存疑

entries.zh: 重言；反复言说（向主人再三陈说、絮叨）
entries.en: to repeat one's words, to say a thing over and over (to the master/owner)
entries.notes: 义据「重言」与西语「dice muchas veces al dueño」互证，惟声调号有 T99 污损故列低置信

entries.zh: 字面「捡死人」，与西语短语「杀一人」不合，疑有误字，释义存疑
entries.en: literally 'to pick up a dead person', at odds with the Spanish qualifier 'to kill a man'; gloss doubtful
entries.notes: 中文栏与西语「matar a un hombre」语义不合，音写第二字有 T99 污损，无法定夺

entries.zh: 逼债；催讨债务（因债苦苦催逼）
entries.en: to dun, to press importunately for payment of a debt

entries.zh: 浸、泡渍（次字存疑：清／湫；「浸」与词头义关联不明，释义存疑）
entries.en: to soak, to steep [second character uncertain; link with the headword unclear]
entries.notes: 次字存疑（清／湫）且声调号 T99 污损，「浸」义与 importunar 难以互证

entries.zh: 错乱冒失、冒犯〔西语短语「in quieras」难释，释义存疑〕
entries.en: rash and presumptuous, to offend [Spanish qualifier 'in quieras' obscure; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 西语「in quieras」无法确释，音写有 T99 污损，释义存疑

entries.zh: 吵死人；吵闹纠缠使人不堪（西语夸张作「纠缠并害死一人」）
entries.en: to pester someone to death (Spanish literally 'to importune and kill someone'); to torment with clamor
entries.notes: 首字存疑（噪／吵）且声调号有 T99 污损；义与西语夸张短语相合

entries.zh: 推迫；催逼（以劝诱之言相催）
entries.en: to push and press (with entreaties), to urge someone on importunately

entries.zh: 推并、挤迫〔西语栏残讹（fdz、comedin to）难释，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to push and press along/together [Spanish garbled; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 西语栏「fdz」等残讹难释，音写有 T99 污损，释义存疑

entries.zh: 倚东倚西；四处倚靠纠缠（东家西家到处缠磨，西语作「向所有人纠缠」）
entries.en: to lean now east, now west; to go about importuning everyone

entries.zh: 缠磨不休之人〔西语词头义为「纠缠不休者」，中文栏却作「縫之人」，语义不合，存疑〕
entries.en: an importunate, pestering person [Chinese column reads 'a sewing person', irreconcilable with the headword; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 西语「Ymportuno」与中文栏「縫之人」语义不合，无法定夺

entries.zh: 糊、黏糊之物〔首字存疑：錡／銓；西语尾注「con wagez」难释，释义存疑〕
entries.en: paste, sticky stuff [first character uncertain; Spanish tail 'con wagez' obscure; gloss doubtful]
entries.notes: 首字存疑、西语「con wagez」难释且声调号 T99 污损，无法定夺
